title: Analytic coefficient charts with a dominating nowhere-zero matrix entry
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a normed field over ℚ_ℓ, and R_X the actual integral continuous coefficient object of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let a:R_X^n→R_X^t₀ be a morphism between standard finite free modules. Suppose the scalar extension of coker(a) is pro-etale locally finite free. There is a pro-etale covering V→X on which the normalized coefficient pullback of a is either zero or its continuous matrix in the explicitly constructed standard pullback bases and canonical coefficient realization of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations] has a nowhere-zero entry dominating all entries pointwise in norm. The matrix functions are explicitly the conjugated regular endomorphisms evaluated on the unit section. This statement contains no row divisibility, monomorphism, rational IsIso, complementary rank, or block decomposition, and does not have to supply basis data, the coefficient realization, or its compatibility with scalar extension.

proof.text: Use the zero-neighborhood theorem to obtain a cover on which a point with all zero coefficients has a zero open neighborhood.
At every other point apply the finite continuous ultrametric maximum lemma to all pairs of row and column indices. It yields an open neighborhood with a nowhere-zero dominating coefficient.

Restrict the coefficient inequalities to the open neighborhood by canonical pullback compatibility. Assemble the open neighborhoods into an open cover of each original member and bind these covers to the original pro-etale cover.

theorem integralMatrix_analytic_cover (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (n t₀ : ℕ) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) n ⟶
      Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) t₀)
    (hC : ∃ V : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ k,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).mapMod _).obj
          ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
            (cokernel a)))) :
    ∃ V : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ k,
      let R := condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (V.X k)
      let T := (ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).mapMod
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) ⋙
        Mod.comap (inv (condensedPullbackHom (integralCoeff ℓ E) (V.f k)))
      let f := (integralFiniteFreePullbackIso ℓ E (V.f k) n).inv ≫ T.map a ≫
        (integralFiniteFreePullbackIso ℓ E (V.f k) t₀).hom
      T.map a = 0 ∨ ∃ (i : Fin t₀) (j : Fin n),
        (∀ x, (integralMatrixFunctions ℓ E (V.X k)
          (chartComparison (V.X k) (continuousIntegers ℓ E)) f i j x).val ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ r s x,
          ‖(integralMatrixFunctions ℓ E (V.X k)
            (chartComparison (V.X k) (continuousIntegers ℓ E)) f r s x).val‖ ≤
          ‖(integralMatrixFunctions ℓ E (V.X k)
            (chartComparison (V.X k) (continuousIntegers ℓ E)) f i j x).val‖
